sunoData.title: Dune Caravan Echo
sunoData.tags: Ambient desert game music with slow-evolving handpan pulses, dry frame drums, breathy ney phrases, and distant bowed textures; verse-like sections drift through sun-scorched traversal, pre-drop strips to sparse sand-swept drones, and the main rise adds low percussion, soft desert percussion loops, and shimmering overtones for long caravan crossings. Occasional reversed swells, wind-chime flickers, and subtle sidechain breath give motion; wide, dusty, cinematic mix with intimate detail., ambient
